items.prompt: What does successful UTF-8 decoding establish by itself?

options.text: The monetary field uses the right currency
options.why: Currency belongs to the schema and field contract.

options.text: Every record is valid JSON and CSV at once
options.why: A text encoding is not a record format.

options.text: The bytes can be decoded under that encoding
options.why: Syntax, schema and business validation are separate steps.

items.explanation: Decoding only completes one layer of the boundary. Validate format, schema, units and meaning separately.
